in_sanskrit.name: Dhithi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Memory, Recall
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dhithi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Dhithi means 'memory' or 'recall'. In Hindu mythology, Dhithi is the goddess of memory. She is also known as Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom.
